prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen using a stage layout with clear path choice cards and playful visual styling.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Journey", "body": "Select how you would like to create and adopt your virtual desktop pet.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Path Options", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Trait Setup Screen: Add a new personality trait screen before home intro where users select key behaviors for their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_traits", "home_intro"], "new_pet_traits": {"headline": "Set Your Pet Personality", "body": "Choose traits for your companion to shape how it interacts on your desktop.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Traits", "style": "emphasis", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign In After Adoption Prep: Move the sign_in screen after pet customization screens (pick_friend and upload_photos) right before adoption confirmation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Naming Sub Flow: Insert a dedicated naming screen within the adoption flow to let users formally name their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_naming_flow", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_naming_flow": {"headline": "Name Your Companion", "body": "Give your new pet a name to make official ownership documents.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Restore Sign In Clarification: Clarify sign-in screen copy with instructions on how signing in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Welcome Back to Desktop Pets", "body": "Sign in with your registered account to restore your existing pets and progress.", "hint": "Use the same email or method you used during your previous setup."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Timer and Status: Enable progress visualizer and estimated time indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We are preparing your pet graphics and desktop behaviors. This will only take a moment.", "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop Notification Toggle on Waiting Screen: Add a notification alert option so users get notified when pet setup finishes if they minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Minimize the window anytime. We'll alert you when your pet is ready!"}}
7: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Adoption Certificate Layout: Update adoption certificate layout to two columns, showing pet preview alongside certificate terms.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Review your companion details before completing adoption.", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "preview", "label": "Pet Preview", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}}
8: [finish, hint] Pet Controls Keybinding Banner: Add a hint banner displaying keyboard shortcuts for summoning, controlling, or hiding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Quick Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to open pet controls or hide your pet from your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Press Alt+P to summon controls", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Step Counter Header on Path Selection: Display step progress counter at the top of choose_path screen to anchor user expectations.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true, "hint": "Step 1 of 5: Choose your creation path to get started."}}

Adds a valid pet naming sub-flow screen inside onboarding.

Adds real progress and estimated time indicators to waiting screen during pet rendering.
Adds notification toggle on waiting screen as allowed inside onboarding.
Replaces the adoption certificate component with a pet preview, losing the required official stamp and certificate representation.
